description: An asset's image as a data: URI to put straight into HTML ( or a CSS background), for sandboxes that cannot load images from another site, such as Claude's HTML artifacts. For an animation or rotation frame it returns ONE horizontal sprite strip (all frames side by side, each size×size) plus a CSS snippet that plays it. Shrunk to fit a reply (small sizes are fine for sprites; scale them up in CSS with image-rendering: pixelated). Free.

frameId.description: Frame id from get_asset (an animation, rotation set or edit). Omit for the base image

id.description: Asset ID (from list_assets / get_asset or a previous result)

imageIndex.description: Only this image of the frame (e.g. one facing of a rotation set) instead of the strip

size.description: Pixels per image (square). Lowered automatically if the result would be too long

name: get_image_data
